name: Camera Moves Pro (108+)
summary: Anima qualsiasi immagine con i movimenti coreografati Fuobe (fino a 2 in sequenza) + controllo ottico Wan 2.2 Fun Camera.

source.notes: The template's bypassed 4-step Lightning LoRAs are re-added at strength 0 (a no-op); the fast preset switches them on with the template's own 4-step settings.

inputs.label: What happens in the shot
inputs.default: A quiet harbor at dawn, fishing boats rocking gently, gulls flying over the water, soft golden light

inputs.label: Coreografia Camera (Mix fino a 2)
inputs.help: Scegli 1 o 2 movimenti di camera Fuobe da eseguire in sequenza nella stessa clip.
